name: recorded-scan-option-form-has-no-production-caller
body: `db_recorded_scan` has no production caller inside `src` now that `freshness_facts` uses `db_recorded_scan_result` and `staleness_line` takes the recorded row from the verdict; it survives only as the public `apg::git` fail-closed API used by the e2e crates and named in docs, so remove it when the public surface no longer needs the `Option` projection.
